title: Reviewed transparent small cut-in portraits
description: Source paths are repository-relative; original_sprite is Unity-project-relative. No existing prefab, animation, material or original texture is replaced. Alignment coordinates use a top-left pixel origin.

original_sha256.description: File SHA-256 of the reviewed PNG encoding; retained as provenance. Original identity is enforced through original_rgba_sha256 plus fixed source canvas and renderer slots.

original_rgba_sha256.description: SHA-256 of unmodified decoded RGBA8 bytes in top-left row order, R/G/B/A per pixel. No color conversion, alpha premultiplication or channel changes. The original canvas is independently checked against the reviewed character geometry.

alignment.description: Optional reviewed head-top anchors. If absent, the builder explicitly records use of each alpha bounding box's top-center. Uniform scale is computed from alpha heights (alpha >= 16); the original Transform is never changed.
